programsPreview.heading: A room that fits every age

programs.name: Infants
programs.title: Gentle beginnings
programs.previewBlurb: Responsive, one-on-one care for our youngest: feeding, sleeping, and cuddles on your baby's own rhythm.
programs.body: Our infant room moves at your baby's pace: feeding, sleeping, and cuddles on their own rhythm. Responsive, one-on-one care builds the trust and security that everything else grows from. Daily notes keep you close to every milestone.

programs.name: Toddlers
programs.title: Busy explorers
programs.previewBlurb: First words, first friendships, and lots of movement as toddlers discover the world on their own two feet.
programs.body: First words, first friendships, and endless movement. Toddlers discover the world on their own two feet through sensory play, music, and lots of fresh air, with gentle support for self-help skills along the way.

programs.name: Preschool
programs.title: Curious minds
programs.previewBlurb: Play-based learning with early literacy, numeracy, art, and music that follows where curiosity leads.
programs.body: A play-based curriculum that follows where curiosity leads: early literacy and numeracy, art, music, and science woven into hands-on projects. Children learn to ask questions, work together, and take pride in their ideas.

programs.name: Pre-K
programs.title: Ready for school

programs.body: Our Pre-K year builds the confidence, focus, and social skills that help children step into kindergarten with joy. Children leave Maplewood not just ready for school, but ready for the world: curious, capable, and kind.

about.title: About Us
about.description: Maplewood cares for the whole child: heart, mind, and body. Meet our founder, our values, and the educators who stay and truly know your child.
about.lead: Children don't learn in silos. Their hearts, minds, bodies, and imaginations all grow together, and so we tend to all of them, every day.

story.heading: A second home, by design.
paragraphs: Maplewood began with a simple belief: that the first five years deserve more than a waiting room with toys. We set out to build a place that feels less like a facility and more like a warm, light-filled home, with calm rooms at a child's scale, real green space to explore, and educators who stay.

Fifteen years later, that's still our north star. We keep classes small, invest deeply in our team, and follow a play-based curriculum grounded in how young children actually learn: through wonder, repetition, relationships, and joy.
We never rush childhood. Whether it's a first step, first word, or first friendship, we meet every milestone with patience instead of pressure.

values.heading: Five things we promise every family.

items.title: Safe
items.body: Secure, nurturing spaces where children feel held, physically and emotionally, so they can be brave.

items.title: Seen
items.body: Care is never one-size-fits-all. Every child is known by name, by need, and by what makes them light up.

items.title: Engaged
items.body: Hands-on, play-based days that follow curiosity and build real skills without ever feeling like school.

items.title: Healthy
items.body: Nourishing meals, daily fresh air, rest, and movement: the foundations of a growing body and mind.

items.title: Supported
items.body: An open door for families, daily updates, and a team that partners with you at every step.
